excerpt.zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 面向高频、成本敏感任务，Anthropic称其显著降低运行成本并提升速度，但复杂代理式编程仍更适合更大的模型。
excerpt.en: Claude Haiku 5.5 targets high-volume, cost-sensitive work with lower pricing and faster execution, while larger models remain better for complex agentic coding.

text.zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 是 Anthropic 面向高频、成本敏感工作推出的小型模型。它重点处理摘要、上下文压缩、数据库查询、分类和客户支持等快速、重复性任务，也可作为 Sonnet 5.5 或 Opus 5.5 的编码子代理。
text.en: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic’s small model for high-volume, cost-sensitive work. It is aimed at fast, repetitive tasks such as summarization, context compaction, database queries, classification, and customer support, and can also serve as a coding subagent alongside Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5.

text.zh: 速度与价格带来的变化
text.en: The impact of speed and pricing

text.zh: 官方称，Haiku 5.5 是其迄今最快的模型，并可按 effort 设置在成本与能力之间调节。定价方面，最多 10 万 token 的请求价格比 Haiku 4.5 低 90%，更长请求低 50%；Anthropic估算整体运行成本约下降 75%。Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格也下调 50%，以降低多数代理任务的成本。
text.en: Anthropic says Haiku 5.5 is its fastest model to date and introduces an effort setting that lets users trade cost for capability. For requests up to 100,000 tokens, its listed prices are 90% below Haiku 4.5, while longer requests are 50% cheaper; Anthropic estimates an overall running-cost reduction of about 75%. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads were also cut by 50%, lowering the cost of many agentic tasks.

text.zh: 适用边界与待验证问题
这些变化更适合大规模、范围明确的调用，而不是所有工作负载。Anthropic的对比结果显示，Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5 仍更适合复杂的代理式编程；Haiku 5.5 的优势在于把此前过于昂贵的短任务变得可持续。Asana、HubSpot、AlphaSense 和 Box 的早期测试反馈支持速度、成本或准确率改善，但这些结果来自特定场景，不能直接代表所有生产环境。
text.en: The changes are most relevant to large-scale, narrowly scoped calls rather than every workload. Anthropic’s comparisons still position Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 as better choices for complex agentic coding, while Haiku 5.5 makes previously uneconomical short tasks more practical. Early tests from Asana, HubSpot, AlphaSense, and Box report gains in speed, cost, or accuracy, but those results come from specific environments and do not guarantee the same production outcomes everywhere.

text.zh: Haiku 5.5 已在 Anthropic 平台以及 AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 上提供。它的安全限制也需要纳入部署判断：网络安全场景允许部分防御性工作，但会阻止渗透测试等更易被攻击者滥用的技术。真正的开放问题是，较低单次成本能否在长期运行的代理系统中持续抵消评估、重试和人工监督成本。
text.en: Haiku 5.5 is available through Anthropic’s platform as well as Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Its safeguards also matter operationally: some defensive cybersecurity work is allowed, while penetration testing and techniques considered more readily usable by attackers are blocked. The open question is whether the lower per-call price will continue to offset evaluation, retry, and human-supervision costs in long-running agent systems.
